selected_model: LTX-2.5 Distilled, Q8 DiT, native MLX/Metal
hardware: Mac mini M5 Pro, 64 GB unified memory
decision: Best fit found for this keyframe-driven stylised reel: native Apple GPU inference, multi-image anchors, small controlled shots and repeatable command-line runs. This is a task-specific selection, not a claim of universal best quality.

alternatives_considered.MiniMax H3: Native Metal implementation exists; larger model and less suitable for this short multi-anchor edit. Not installed.
alternatives_considered.LTX-2.3: Older than verified LTX-2.5; not selected.
alternatives_considered.Wan 2.2: Available Apple routes, but lacks this selected native multi-anchor workflow.

render: 576x1024 native, 24fps, 8+3 distilled steps; edit output upscaled to 1080x1920 at 30fps.
audio: Regular generation uses --no-audio. Experimental video-tail extension generates audio; that audio is discarded before editing. Final cut has original procedural SFX only, with no sampled game assets and no music.
ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 9.0.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

weights.role: base components and BF16 Gemma 4 encoder; omitted full-precision transformer and unused LoRA/decoders

continuation: extend --distilled, 25-frame pinned video tail, tested at existing runtime commit 747b30ef10e92a011e85b2aa0f6c4ee86ced5218; see continuity.json and research/LTX_PLAYBOOK.md
